description: Vue.js component definition for media items grid, including template, data, props, created hook, and methods for media management.

methods.name: isMediaSelected
methods.description: Checks if a media item is currently selected based on URL comparison.

methods.name: buildMediaUrl
methods.description: Constructs a media URL with specified thumbnail size parameters.

methods.name: toggleSelectionOfMedia
methods.description: Emits an event to toggle media selection.

methods.name: renameMedia
methods.description: Emits an event to request renaming a media item.

methods.name: deleteMedia
methods.description: Emits an event to delete a media item.

methods.name: dragStart
methods.description: Emits an event to initiate dragging of a media item.

methods.name: getfontAwesomeClassNameForFileName
methods.description: Generates Font Awesome class name based on filename and thumbnail size.
